content: For every preprint announced today (not just in mathematics), I get the error "HTML or source was not provided to generate HTML or a PDF." when trying to access the pdf or source. I'm surprised to have not seen any noise about this online. Is anyone else having this issue?
hi, yesterday I was told the arxiv was not functioning for a while, but it resumed at 2:30 BST. maybe that outage caused further issues?
